meta.name: Alicia's Law
meta.description: When her carefully built life comes undone, Alicia returns to practicing law and discovers that rebuilding her career also means redefining herself.

videos.title: The Fall Down
videos.overview: When her husband's salacious scandal forces Alicia to reset her whole life, she returns to law and takes on a heavy case to compete for a permanent job.

videos.title: Custody Battle
videos.overview: As Alicia struggles to balance work and motherhood, she takes on a custody battle between a mother and grandmother — and uncovers a troubling truth.

videos.title: Like Family
videos.overview: Alicia defends a domestic worker accused of theft, drawing media attention that puts the firm's public image — and her own reputation — under scrutiny.

videos.title: The Right to Die
videos.overview: After taking on a terminally ill businesswoman's fight to die with dignity, Alicia must unravel a dispute over the client's marriage, company and legacy.

videos.title: The Kiss
videos.overview: As her search for a terrified Pilar intensifies, Alicia represents a young pop star who has accused her longtime manager of grooming and harassment.

videos.title: The Scholarship
videos.overview: Despite disturbing evidence, Alicia defends a powerful family's son — and a candid TV interview forces her to confront how the public views her new life.

videos.title: Succession
videos.overview: Alicia assists a wealthy widow who was conned by a young lover. As uncertainty at the firm grows, Aurelio considers a deal to get out of prison.

videos.title: Criminal Profile
videos.overview: While defending an Oaxacan man jailed for an attack, Alicia confronts the biases coloring the case and considers a job offer from Sandra Moreno.

videos.title: Of Life and Death
videos.overview: Katya's search for Pilar's laptop takes an unexpectedly dangerous turn. When a mother and baby both die during childbirth, Alicia takes on their case.

videos.title: Over the Edge
videos.overview: After a bullied student nearly dies at Iker and Greta's school, Alicia targets the institution as her own family's tensions reach a breaking point.
